text:
violet: Customer can't finish quickstart. First outbound request fails with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, SDK retries, later shows onboarding banner that says 'billing required' and user is confused.

violet: They ran:
```
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=pk_trial_XXX redwood/quickstart:latest node index.js
```

kevin: Likely corporate TLS interception + VPN split routing. Container/Node doesn't trust intercept CA so handshake fails. Banner is misleading.

support-bot: Workspace 'sunrise-app' is on trial. Trial limits exist but trial state isn't causing TLS failures. Banner triggered by repeated failures (generic).

violet: Customer ran `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and saw issuer=Corp-Intercept-Proxy and "certificate verify failed".

infra-bot: Note INFRA-3621 and INFRA-3702 track missing host CA in some images and WSL2/VPN DNS flakiness.

kevin: Quick unblocks: run quickstart on personal laptop or cloud devbox; set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS to company CA; mount host CA into container; avoid `--insecure`.

support-bot: We'll offer a hosted devbox for onboarding if customer can't change machine. Also filing DOCS ticket to add "Corporate proxy" troubleshooting and examples.

onboard-bot: Added workspace note: "offer hosted devbox; clarify onboarding banner; add proxy troubleshooting".

violet: Product asks: change onboarding banner copy and SDK diagnostics so TLS verify errors show a friendly hint (link to doc) instead of generic billing message.

kevin: I'll open small PR to update quickstart README with Docker/Node/Windows examples and a sample `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` snippet. Also propose SDK change to alias CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED to a specific help link.

violet: Thanks. Customer accepted hosted devbox and completed onboarding. Closing support case after docs/SDK updates. :white_check_mark:
